items.value: Late for School
You were late for school due to a bus traffic jam.
Apologize to the teacher.
I apologized and was allowed into class.
Sneak into class.
I tried to sneak in without the teacher noticing.
Explain the reason to her.
The teacher understood my situation.
Locker Trouble
You forgot to open your locker on time.
Ask a friend for help.
My friend helped me get my books.
Go ask the monitor.
I went to find the monitor to get my locker opened.
Wait until recess to open it.
I decided to wait until recess, even if it meant missing some notes.
Science Group Project
You are working on a science project with your group.
Work together.
We collaborated well and made good progress.
Do minimal work.
I didn't contribute much to the project.
Argue heatedly with a friend.
We had a big argument over the project details.
P.E. Class: Basketball
It's time for basketball in P.E. class.
Play your best.
I had a great time playing and got some good exercise.
Say you're tired and sit out.
I wasn't feeling up for it today.
Sit on the sidelines and cheer.
I supported my friends from the bench.
English Presentation
You have to give a presentation in English class.
Prepare thoroughly.
I was well-prepared and gave a confident presentation.
Read from the paper.
I just read my notes without making eye contact.
Speak hesitantly and without confidence.
I was too nervous to speak clearly.
Student Council
You are considering running for student council.
Run for office seriously.
I gave a serious speech and campaigned hard.
Make slightly exaggerated promises.
I might have promised more than I can deliver.
Speak little, mostly listen.
I decided to observe this year instead of running.
Lunch in the Cafeteria
It's lunchtime. Who do you sit with?
Sit with your best friend.
I had a nice chat with my best friend over lunch.
Sit with your crush.
My heart was pounding the whole time!
Sit alone quietly.
I enjoyed some peaceful time by myself.
School Dance
There's a small school dance happening.
Ask a friend to dance.
We had a lot of fun dancing together.
Stand shyly on the sidelines.
I was too shy to ask anyone to dance.
Stand in a corner and observe.
I enjoyed watching everyone else have fun.
Science Experiment
You are conducting a science experiment.
Follow the instructions.
The experiment went smoothly.
Try your own way.
I decided to experiment a little on my own.
Observe to learn.
I watched my classmates to see how they did it.
Pop Quiz
The teacher announces a surprise pop quiz.
Do your best.
I answered to the best of my ability.
Look at a friend's paper.
I tried to get a little help from my friend.
Just write down anything to finish.
I just wanted to get it over with.
Got a Late Slip
You were caught sneaking in and got a late slip.
Ask the teacher for a chance.
I pleaded with the teacher, but still got the slip.
Accept the punishment.
I accepted the consequences of my actions.
Explain the bus broke down.
I tried to explain my situation.
Punished for Tardiness
You were punished for being late to class because of your locker.
Apologize to the teacher.
I apologized for being late.
Accept writing a reflection.
I had to write a reflection paper.
Suggest changing locker opening times.
I suggested a change to the school rules.
Ostracized by the Group
Your group members are ignoring you for not contributing.
Apologize and make up for it.
I apologized and promised to do my share.
Find another group.
I decided to find a new group to work with.
Try to prove your ability.
I tried to show them I could be a valuable member.
Reprimanded by Teacher in P.E.
The teacher reprimanded you for skipping P.E.
Go back and participate.
I rejoined the class activity.
Explain you were really tired.
I insisted that I wasn't feeling well.
Accept a deduction in grade.
I accepted that my grade would be lowered.
Reprimanded for Reading from Paper
The teacher reprimanded you for reading directly from your paper.
Try to speak in your own words.
I tried to ad-lib the rest of my presentation.
Apologize and continue.
I apologized and continued reading.
Sit down and wait for another turn.
I was too embarrassed to continue.
Teased by Friends
Your friends are teasing you for your exaggerated promises.
Joke back to lighten the mood.
I laughed along with them.
Explain your good intentions.
I tried to explain what I meant.
Silently ignore it.
I didn't let their teasing bother me.
Teased for Sitting with Crush
Your friends are teasing you for sitting with your crush.
Pretend not to hear.
I acted like I didn't hear them.
Smile and continue sitting.
I wasn't going to let them ruin the moment.
Move to another table.
I got flustered and moved away.
Dragged Out to Dance
Your friends dragged you onto the dance floor.
Join in and dance for fun.
I decided to let loose and had a great time.
Smile awkwardly and stand aside.
I still felt too shy to dance.
Try dancing for a bit then rest.
I danced for one song and then went back to the sidelines.
Minor Incident
There was a small incident during your experiment.
Report to the teacher.
I told the teacher what happened right away.
Fix it correctly.
I managed to fix my mistake.
Laugh it off and continue.
It wasn't a big deal, so I just moved on.
Warning from Invigilator
The invigilator warned you for cheating.
Apologize.
I apologized and stopped cheating.
Argue back.
I insisted that I wasn't cheating.
Accept a poor grade.
I accepted the consequences and got a zero.
Class Debate
There is a debate in class.
State your opinion clearly.
I participated actively in the debate.
Remain silent and listen.
I preferred to listen to others' opinions.
Participate a little then stop.
I shared one thought and then listened.
After-School Sports
You are playing sports after school.
Join the team.
I decided to join the school team.
Play for fun with friends.
We had a casual game with friends.
Sit and cheer.
I watched my friends play.
Class Trip to the Bookstore
Your class is on a trip to the bookstore.
Buy textbooks.
I bought the books I needed for class.
Buy comic books.
I found some cool new comics.
Wander around and browse.
I just enjoyed looking at all the books.
Doing Homework
It's time to do your homework.
Complete it fully.
I finished all of my homework.
Do half of it.
I only did the easy parts.
Ask a friend and copy.
I copied the answers from my friend.
Praised by Teacher
The teacher praised you.
Smile proudly.
It felt good to be praised.
Blush shyly.
I was a bit embarrassed by the attention.
Pretend to be indifferent.
I acted like it was no big deal.
Criticized by Teacher
The teacher criticized you.
Listen silently.
I took the criticism quietly.
Explain the reason.
I tried to explain my side of the story.
Feel sad and reflect.
The criticism made me feel down.
Extracurricular Activity
You are participating in an extracurricular activity.
Participate enthusiastically.
I was very involved in the activity.
Participate partially.
I only did the parts I was interested in.
Sit and watch your friends.
I preferred to watch.
Class Picnic
The class is having a picnic.
Participate in group games.
The group games were a lot of fun.
Eat alone.
I wanted some quiet time.
Go sightseeing and take pictures.
I explored the area and took some photos.
Helping a Friend with Studies
A friend needs help with their studies.
Explain it to your friend.
I was happy to help my friend understand.
Lend them your notebook.
I let them borrow my notes.
Study together.
We studied together and both learned a lot.
Final Exam Day
It is the day of the final exam.
Review thoroughly.
I felt well-prepared for the exam.
Review superficially.
I did a quick review before the exam.
Guess while doing it.
I had to guess on many questions.
Class Meeting
There is a class meeting.
Participate in speaking.
I shared my thoughts with the class.
Sit and listen.
I listened to what others had to say.
Joke with a friend.
I was distracted and didn't pay attention.
Meeting a Teacher Outside School
You meet a teacher outside of school.
Greet them politely.
I greeted my teacher respectfully.
Give a forced smile.
It was a bit awkward.
Pretend not to see them.
I tried to avoid them.
New Student Arrives
A new student has transferred to your class.
Actively get to know them.
I introduced myself and made them feel welcome.
Sit at the same table.
We sat together and had a nice conversation.
Wait for them to initiate conversation.
I waited for them to talk to me first.
Playing Online Games
You are playing online games.
Play for fun with friends.
We had a great time playing together online.
Play for too long.
I played for too long and felt tired the next day.
Do not participate.
I'm not interested in online games.
Sports Festival
It's the school's sports festival.
Compete in the race.
I ran in the race.
Compete in the long jump.
I participated in the long jump event.
Be a cheerleader.
I cheered for my classmates.
Chemistry Experiment
You are doing a chemistry experiment.
Follow the instructions.
I carefully followed the steps.
Creatively add details.
I added a few extra steps to see what would happen.
Observe your friends do it.
I watched how my friends did the experiment.
Foreign Visitor in Class
A foreign visitor is in your class.
Actively start a conversation.
I had a great conversation with the visitor.
Smile and say hello.
I gave them a friendly welcome.
Remain silent.
I was too shy to talk to them.
Art Class
It's art class.
Draw according to the assignment.
I followed the assignment for my drawing.
Draw creatively.
I drew something from my imagination.
Sit and watch.
I wasn't in the mood to draw today.
Receive Exam Results
You have received your exam results.
Joyfully show them to your friends.
I was happy with my results and shared them with my friends.
Keep them quiet.
I kept my results to myself.
Feel sad.
I was disappointed with my results.
Sharing Lunch
You are sharing lunch with friends.
Give a portion to a friend.
I shared some of my food with my friend.
Trade dishes.
We traded some of our food.
Keep your portion.
I was really hungry today.
Science Club
Explore the world of science and conduct fun experiments. For future scientists.
Art Club
Develop your creativity and express yourself through various art forms. For future artists.
Sports Club
Improve physical fitness and teamwork through sports. For future athletes.
Debate Club
Enhance critical thinking and public speaking skills. For future leaders and lawyers.
Robotics Club
Design, build, and program robots. For future engineers and innovators.
Music Club
Explore the world of music, learn an instrument, and perform. For future musicians.
Cooking Club
Learn culinary skills and explore the world of food. For future chefs.
Coding Club
Learn how to code and develop software. For future programmers.
Photography Club
Capture moments and tell stories through the lens. For future photographers.
Writing Club
Develop your writing skills and express your ideas through text. For future writers and journalists.
Entrepreneurship Club
Learn the basics of business, finance, and leadership. For future CEOs.
Model UN Club
Debate global issues and learn about international relations. For future diplomats.
Environmental Club
Take action on environmental issues and promote sustainability. For future scientists and activists.
Volunteering Club
Give back to the community and help those in need. For future social workers and humanitarians.
Chess Club
Sharpen your mind and master the art of strategy. For future grandmasters of all fields.
Film & Media Club
Explore the world of filmmaking, from screenwriting to production. For future storytellers.
Future Medical Professionals Club
Get a head start on a career in medicine. For future doctors and nurses.
Astronomy Club
Explore the cosmos, from planets to distant galaxies. For future astronomers and engineers.
Literary Magazine Club
Create and publish the school's literary journal. For future writers and editors.
Architecture & Engineering Club
Design and build amazing structures. For future architects and engineers.
Business Pitch Competition
The Entrepreneurship Club is hosting a business pitch competition. This is your chance to shine!
Present your innovative idea.
My pitch was a huge success! I think I have a future in business.
Help a friend with their presentation.
I helped my friend, and they did great. Teamwork makes the dream work!
Model UN Conference
The Model UN Club is attending a regional conference. It's time to represent our school.
Take the lead in debate.
I passionately debated our resolution and won an award!
Focus on networking with other delegates.
I made some great connections with students from other schools.
Community Cleanup Initiative
The Environmental Club is organizing a community cleanup day.
Recruit volunteers and lead a team.
We collected so much trash! It feels good to make a difference.
Work quietly on your own.
I focused on cleaning up my assigned area and did a thorough job.
Charity Fundraiser Gala
The Volunteering Club is hosting a fundraiser for a local charity.
Organize the event logistics.
The event went off without a hitch! We raised a lot of money for a good cause.
Donate a large portion of your allowance.
It was a big sacrifice, but it was worth it to help others.
National Chess Tournament
The Chess Club is competing in the national tournament.
Execute a brilliant strategy.
Checkmate! I won the tournament with a daring queen sacrifice.
Play it safe and aim for a draw.
I played conservatively and managed to secure a respectable draw against a tough opponent.
Short Film Festival
The Film & Media Club is hosting its first-ever short film festival.
Submit your own film.
My film won the audience award! I'm so proud of my work.
Help with the event organization.
I helped run the projector and everything went smoothly. It was fun to be behind the scenes.
First Aid/CPR Certification Drive
The Future Medical Professionals Club is offering a first aid certification course.
Master the techniques and teach others.
I'm now certified in CPR and first aid! I even helped teach some of my classmates.
Just get the certification.
I passed the course and got my certification. It's a valuable skill to have.
Stargazing Night & Telescope Building
The Astronomy Club is hosting a stargazing night.
Build a powerful telescope.
I built my own telescope and saw the rings of Saturn! It was incredible.
Just enjoy the view.
I lay back and watched the stars. It was a beautiful and peaceful night.
Launch of the School's Literary Journal
The Literary Magazine Club is launching the first issue of the school journal.
Read your poem aloud at the launch party.
I was nervous, but everyone loved my poem! It was a great experience.
Work as the editor for the journal.
I worked hard to edit all the submissions. The final journal looks amazing.
Bridge Building Competition
The Architecture & Engineering Club is hosting a bridge building competition.
Design an innovative and strong bridge.
My bridge held the most weight! My design was a success.
Focus on the aesthetics of the bridge.
My bridge might not have been the strongest, but it was definitely the best-looking one.
